cases.name: Historical charge and cumulative stage/B/C ceilings cannot be reset or overreserved
Concurrent reservations admit at most four combined workers and one local worker
CPU leases are unique per host and immutable attempt identifiers reject duplicate dispatch
Unresolved and failed launches retain full CPU charge and cannot silently retry
Only verified completion releases a running slot; malformed/stale transitions fail
Absolute stage/B/C deadlines prevent new work and C remains locked without its recorded gate
Local RAM tier and remote admission limits fail closed before dispatch
Inherited request/byte counters, stopped service and metadata-only bucket cannot be bypassed
Immutable bundle/attempt output identity and source hash mismatch stop processing
Private response/error sentinel cannot enter public process receipts
Endpoint metadata diagnostics validate every requested row ID before TID-presence counting and never emit values
Same-host comparison blocks and deterministic fixture results reconcile across worker partitions
